notes: TBox rule edit. Derivability very_unlikely: the ensemble's make-up is its definition, stated everywhere. No real exceptions: works for other string combinations are named otherwise (Schubert's string quintet with two cellos, the Trout Quintet with double bass). Determinate queries use new works named in the prompt; the background-belief queries use two well-known quartets whose names avoid the word 'string', and the two storage choices are independent, so there are four worlds. In the by-name worlds the work keeps its cello and its class membership gives way: it is no longer a string quartet under the new rule (README, TBox); it is never an exception to the rule. Membership is not entailed by other firm facts: the catalogue titles ('String Quartet No. 14') are names, and a string quartet is defined by its instruments. Plausibility: the double bass is the other bowed bass instrument; clearly false. Near query: the piano trio, whose answer differs from the new one.
